content: Emo zo mene nona we bure sesena auna ge ungwe.
Iya be aune Yesu mene gare atu wosiro ou nazi deung bera bage atu adungno mitina ara.
Atu mitinu emo bauno dubu bainakama mene nuna-una kasa yewa ara. Kasa yewa giro nung wang zora witiro adungno mitinu emo bauno dubu baina mene zo awong ika atu dopewa ara.
Ayero yewa Yesu mene ge eniya ena sinasani kotumao daigairo awong eno tugata nena. Tugata nasani ge eyero sena, “Sana nigipu. Emo zo mene nona we bure atu sesari sero baungna ara.
Baungno nona we bure atu sesinenu we ena nagibe atu wosiwa. Atu wosiro daung mokera mitiwa ni mamani mene taungno miniro aung yewa ara.
We ena awiya tawing daba tame soyao auna wosiwa ara. Tawing awiya sori oko, arare we amimene mena pusasa yewa ara.
Ayero yewa tatai nunae mene imokore oko wosiro baunare wari mene witiro awenu irara yero auno aung yewa ara.
We ena awiya tawing i nawe tatai mitiwa auna wosiwa ara. We awiya i nawere dema apakana tetemo pusasa yewa i nawe mene nona awiya denu me oko iyao yena ara.
We ena awiya tawing me gawire auna wosiro me daigairo iwa ara. Nona wosiro pusasa yero iropumuwa auna zora me nuna 100, zora me 60, ora zora me mene zo 30, ayero kasa yewa ara.
Arare zo nung dawongne mene ge awiya nigaise.” Ayero sena ara.
Yesu mene ge eniya sinasani nauna auna susuwa.
Ge ayero senu buro-mani nuna mene nuna-una nugu baungno atata yero sewa, “Ning noeno ge eniya ena awiya awong eno sinosi?”
Ayero sewa Yesu mene abena eyero sena, “Tuwa Bayau nata Tuwa yero nariniya auna ge pungyero mitoiya, auna susuwa awiya niye ena mene nigaese sao mitiya ara. Arata emo bauno ena awiya aung ara.

Zo nung nona nung eno pugao awiya puro nai giro nupema memani pugana nung zamena simena baina tamariniya. Arata zo nung nona nung eno pugao awiya doro aung nai giro na nona nuna sorero pumana nung teba aung nariniya ara.
Awong diti moko nunae mene gosinowa, arata oko giro baingtitinowa. Awong dawong mene ungwe nigitinowa, arata ungwena susuwa awiya oko giro baingtitinowa. Aeno na ge eniya awiya awong eno sinona.
Arare ge zo porofete Yesaya mene gaena ge awiya nunae-una atu me niya. Ge awiya eyero mitiya,

content.text: arata susuwa nuna oko nigiro baingtarineya.
Niye diti moko ninae mene garineya,
arata susuwa nuna oko giro baingtarineya.

content: Emo dubu ewiya awong kotumao aung.

content.text: arare ge oko nigao yero nowa.
Ayero oko yao yateya, awiya diti moko mene nonana susuwa gateya; arita dawong mene gera susuwa nigateya; nupema dubo mene nonana susuwa nigiro baingtateya.
Ayero oko yao yateya, awiya awong dubo darawa yaya na awong kora yatena.

content: Ninae mene zo diti moko pagairo giro baingtitinowa. Nupema dawong yawero nigitinowa. Arare niye yawa yawa yero nowa.

Na ge me sane. Gitau porofete daigairo aune etutero nao emo daigairo awong amimene nona gosineya awiya gari aratapu nasani nauwa, arata awong oko gao yero nawe mamagayewa. Awong ge nigitinowa awiya nigari aratapu nasani nauwa, arata oko nigao yero nawe mamagayewa.
Nona we bure atu sesaora ge eniya auna susuwa sena.
Arare nona me bure sesaora ge eniya sesena auna susuwa nuna awiya keregairo sana nigipu.

Nona we ena nagibe atu wosina auna susuwa eyao era: Emo zo uritira ge nigitinoi susuwa oko kasa yao noi pasenana maung mene nuna-una kasa yero uritira ge dubo nuna-una toitinoiya awiya puro tara yero noiya ara.
Ora nona we ena awiya tawing daba tame soyao auna wosina, auna susuwa eyao era: Zo nung uritira ge nigiro mena puro yawa yawa yero noiya.
Arata nung tatai aung, arare nung be apungkaka gege Tuwara nagibora nariniya. Ayero nai uritira gera iwo kasa yai nung mena yangduwariniya ara.

Ora nona we ena i nawe towang wosina auna susuwa eyao era: Zo nung uritira ge nigitinoiya, arata nung tawingna nona eno kotung-katung noi wau moni mene nung etegatinoiya, arare tani ayao amimene uritira ge wori nowa me oko kasa yero noiya.

Ora nona we ena tawing gawire auna wosina auna susuwa eyao era: Zo nung uritira ge nigitinoi susuwa kasa yero noiya. Nung amimene me itinoiya. We zora me 100, zora me 60, zora me 30, ayao ine kasa yero noiya ara.” Ge ayero sena arauwa.
Wuit towang atu i nawe dema pusasa yao auna ge eniya.
Ayero sero ge eniya zo dema eyero sena, “Uritira mitoiya amimene nata Tuwa yero nariniya auna susuwa awiya eyero pugairo sana teng yae. Emo zo mene wuit me iwaing bure atu sesena.
Me sesena aune ping tuno tano iwo nuna mene kasa yero wuit auna towang atu i-we zo goru nuna wuitra ine auna me awiya puro baungno sesero doro tara yena.
Ayero yenu wuit aune i-we aune teng pusasa yewa. Pusasa yero me iwa aune i-we auna benaung kasa daung yena ara.
Ayero yenu mani sou mene giro buro maung tugata yero eyero sewa, “Emo tuwa, ning buro nina auna nona me iwaing gege sesasa, arata i-we meko ewiya natu buro pusasa niye?” Ayero atata yewa sena,
“Awiya iwo zo mene sesena amimene pusasa niya.” Ayero senu nupema atata yero sewa, “Ayero nae baungno i-we awiya sumanenese kotupunesita?”
Ge ayero sewa abena eyero sena, “Aungwa. Niye i-we supunasani wuit dema sumowi sero yangdopu.

Wuit awiya i-we aune dema teng mitete iropaeto. Ago wuit me pumaora be kasa yai aune me pumaora emo mene gitau i-we meko awiya suno tairo tiro iyaora igiyaese sarinena. Arata wuit me gege etutero garo nana-una zuwagaese sarinena.” Yesu mene ayero sena arauwa.
I mastet aune yis aune auna ge eniya.
Yesu mene ge eniya zo eyero sena, “Tuwa Bayau nata Tuwa yero nariniya, awiya i mastet ayero sero nonane auna me ine ara. Emo awong i me awiya puro bure nunae-una atu urinowa.
Urinowa pusasa yero bairo nona we ena bure atu urinonane awiya apakana daigairo baina noiya. Ayero noi bowang nuna babuze kasa nowa ni mamani mene utung nuna-una buro bowangna atu uwang gapunowa.”

Yesu mene ayero sero ge eniya zo eyero dema sena, “Tuwa Bayau nata Tuwa yero nariniya auna susuwa awiya yis ine. Bauno zo mene tao baina zora atu plaware yisre pugairo dawenu yis toiro plawa punu titisero daing yena ara.” Ayero sena arauwa.
Yesu mene ge eniya gege sinauna.
Yesu mene emo bauno ge tugata yero nasani nauna, awiya ge eniya gege sinauna ara. Ge keregairo oko sao yena.
Ayero yenu porofete zo mene gitau ge eyero sena awiya me yena,

content.text: Na ge eniya sinasani kotumao pungyao tawing kasa
yena aune kasa yero butunoiya awiya keregarinena.

content: Wuit towang atu i-we pusasa yaora ge eniya auna susuwa keregaina.

Yesu mene emo bauno senu bautunewa nung garo nuna-una witina ara. Witiro mitinu buro-mani nuna mene nuna-una baungno eyero sewa, “Ning wuit bure atu i-we enana ge sesesa auna susuwa se nae niganene.” Ayero keregaise sewa giro sena,
“Emo we iwaing sesena nung awiya Emora Mani.
Buro awiya tawing apakana auna teng ara. We iwaing awiya uritira gerao dubu ara. Ora i-we awiya pasenana maung auna mani awiso.
Iwo mene i-we sesena awiya Sanda. Wuit me pumaora be awiya be baina. Me pumaora emo awiya angelo dubu.
I-we suno iyaora igitinowa susuwa ayao awiya be bainana atu kasa yariniya.
Be bainana atu na Emora Mani mene angelo dubu nana iyengtana wosiro pasena yumaora nona arita emo pasena yero nowa awiya apakana yangtagairo emo tuwa yaora masi nana yangdoro
iyao tauyao awao gege awinoiya auna augarineya ara. Ayero yaya atu zi irare barare sinasani engweze-pangweze nasani mitarineya.
Be aune emo etutero nao awong Maung nunae-una atu nasani wari posinoiya ayao ine posero waegarineya. Zo nung dawongne mene ge ewiya nigiro baingtaise.
Emo zo mene wau moni baina tauna auna ge eniya.

Tuwa Bayau nata Tuwa yero nariniya auna susuwa eyao era. Maguro zo wau moni bainane tawing agewa zora atu pungyao mitauna, awiya emo zo mene taungno nupema pungyenu kayero mitinu nung yawa yawa nasani nona-owi nuna awiya apakana emo eno pugairo aung yenu nung eno zuma pugaiwa puro baungno tawing agewa awiya zuma gaero pungna arauwa.
Zewe zaima auna ge eniya.
Nupema Tuwa Bayau nata Tuwa yero nariniya auna susuwa awiya eyao era. Emo zo nung zewe zaima tamaora buro yero nauna.

Ayero kaunawe iwaing zo taungno giro nona-owi nuna apakana emo eno pugainu aung yenu nung eno zuma pugaiwa puro baungno zewe zaima awiya zuma gaero pungna ara.” Ayero sena ara. Name tawingna nona me aung awiya doro kotumao naname puro pu uritira gairo nanenese auna sena.
Mogara ge eniya.
Yesu mene eyero sena, “Tuwa Bayau nata Tuwa yero nari niya auna susuwa awiya moga ine. Emo mene moga witora augairo wo ewego-papego benaung giti watimuwa.
Ayero yewa wo be bunu watimuwa witi ika yenu emo adungno wo yangtagati nasani wo minao awiya puro pu taora gaiwa. Ora oko minao ami zo augairo yangduwa ara.
Tawingna be aung nai aune susuwa ayao ine kasa yariniya. Be auna atu angelo awong tawing sero sero auna atu baungno emo bauno iwawaing auna towang atu emo bauno memeko-mameko yangta gatigairo
iyao tauyao nibamu awao gege awinasani mitoiya auna augaya babarineya. Ayero yaya atu zi irare barare sinasani engweze-pangweze nasani mitarineya.”
Yesu mene ayero sero atata yero sena, “Niye ge apakana auna susuwa nigiro baingtitineita?” Ayero senu awong eyero sewa, “Nigiro baingtitinonane.”

Ayero sewa giro eyero sena, “Buro-mani nana zo mene Tuwa Bayau nata Tuwa yero nariniya auna susuwa awiya nigitinoiya amimene garo maung zo ine ara. Garo maung mene nona mature sekare garo nuna-una pugairo diya noi emo ena mene nona kau nowa giro garo mokora atu puro emo nona kau nowa aeno pugatinoiya. Deka ayero buro-mani nana mene kotumao mature sekare amaze puro nasani emo bauno gipari yero giro puro gipariniya.” Ayero sena arauwa.
Nasarete napora emo mene Yesu bauta potewa.
Yesu mene ge eniya benaung giti awiya sinete sero aung yero tawing awiya doro baungna ara.
Ayero baungno napo nuna-una kasa yero yere ibu nunae-una toiro uritira ge tugata yenu emo mene wawong di gauno eyero sewa, “Emo ewiya nigao baina aune tani putoungne yao awiya natu taungni?

Name susuwa nuna gosinenane. Nung kapendara mani ara. Ai nuna yazo Maria. Aune metamani nuna yazo nunae Yakoboto Yosefe, aune Simonto Yuda. Nupema numono mani nuna apakana awiya nae aune dema yero nowa.
Arare emo ewiya nigao baina awiya natu taungni?”

Ayero sero nung eno kotumao meko pumuwa ara. Ayero yewa Yesu mene awong eno eyero sena, “Porofete awong emo yazore. Arata napo nunae-una atu, o mamono nunae-una atu awong emo yazo aung.” Ayero sena ara.
Napo auna emo awong nung tumo oko diyao yewa, arare nung tani putoungne ena daigairo nunae-una atu oko yero nauna.
